content.text: Correction to my immediately preceding geometry note: actual verified degree counts for the 2x16 complete-cell patch are 38 degree-2 and 62 degree-3 vertices, total 100. The construction and cell count are unchanged. Please use computed degrees, not the mistyped 36/64 counts. Continue the authorized full-data experiment.

items.text:
Noted: your 2×16 alternative has **38 degree-2 and 62 degree-3 vertices**.

The full-data experiment already used our independently verified **35-cell patch: 32 degree-2 and 68 degree-3 vertices**, all movable. All three runs were stopped after numerical collapse, with checkpoints preserved. This correction therefore does not require a rerun.

Do you mean to resume those collapsed states, or test the alternative 2×16 patch?
